handouts.title: The notice on the gate
draft: Pinned over a dozen older notices just like it. Somebody has drawn a ship in the margin.

handouts.title: The commission
draft: COMMISSION, Sallow's Exchange, by order of {merchant}, {refinery_row}.
Wanted: the safe return of {petra}, last seen entering {undercourses} by the Refinery Row culvert.
Pay on delivery. One previous engagement unconcluded. Loaned gear to be returned whole or paid for.

handouts.title: The sellswords' journal
lore: Something in the big cistern. Lamps don't scare it. Light does.
draft: Kept by Harl Venn, of the Coldwater crew the Knotted Gull (the mark on the cover: a gull over a knotted net). Crew: Harl Venn, Mags Orrin, Teague Pell.
(The last page. The earlier pages are tallies of pay and complaints about the smell.)

handouts.title: The bill for the loaners
draft: SALLOW'S EXCHANGE. Loaned and not returned whole:
Four blades, bent and chipped: 20 gold crowns.
One charge lamp, mirror cracked: 6 gold crowns.
One pry bar, tooth marks: 4 gold crowns.
Total 30 gold crowns. Paid. The goods are now the borrowers' own.

handouts.title: The binding receipt
draft: Bindings at F-grade: four. Paid in cash. No debt recorded.
The Compact accepts no liability for discomfort, collapse, or what the bound do next.

board.name: The broker's board (F-grade)
board.note: Draft by Claude: filler commissions for after the act (chapter-1-plan.md 'Filler and grind in Ashford').
results: Rat cull in the outer Undercourses: clear a rat swarm. 2 gp.
A delivery across districts: a sealed crate from the quay to Refinery Row, before the shift bell. 1 gp.
A lost cat in the canal: it is on a barge, and the barge is moving. 5 sp.
Scrap and charge cells in the workshop alley: gather six (Crafting or Investigation). 1 gp, or keep two cells.
Herbs by the canal: a Physician wants twenty sprigs of saltwort (Nature or Survival). 1 gp.
Tide tables at the harbour office: copy a month of tables before the clerk notices (Cartography). 2 gp.
The training yard at the port: three practice bouts at F-grade, no risk. 1 gp for winning two.
A page of the legends' lost journal is rumoured somewhere in Ashford Roads. No pay. Ask around.
